comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
I looked up some information about Hawaii port... it will actually be part of the West Coast of Latin America port permit map, although they will speak Oceania language and have the Oceania menu to order at the barkeep (Spit roasted crocodile, Kangaroo tail soup, etc, NOT all those food items as seen here!)

Hawaii will have the following trade goods for sale:
Coconut Vinegar
Taro
Cassava
Macadamia Nuts
Papayas
Pineapples (will require investment and a certain development level to show up)
Sandalwood (will require investment and a certain development level to show up)

The Item Shop there will have the following for sale:
Wood Spear
Hunter's Spear
Fishing Gear
Catapult
Boomerang
Strong Adhesive Oil
Secret Medication
Assorted Medications

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: There's a new cookbook in the Item Shop! It's called Southern Island Food Recipe v1 and it sells for 100k, no investment needed to have it appear. The recipes start at R4, and go up as high as R11. A few of those recipes are probably connected to the newest MA, Pacific Speciality Dishes, but I haven't made anything from it yet, so... I dunno which ones. Sorry!

comments.author: Wystein
comments.body:
There is one recipe in the Southern Island Food Recipe v1 and one recipe in the Southern Island Food Recipe v2 books that are part of the Pacific Speciality Dishes Memorial Album. I don't have the books anymore so can't name the recipe but the dishes are Kalua Pork and Kelaguen.

Other dishes for the MA that I know are Onigiri, Yukejang, Oyster Omelette and Shumai. This recipes are in the Japan, Korean, Taiwan & China cuisine books or can just be purchased at taverns in EA. There remains 4 more dishes that I don't know.
